At GTL Infrastructure, we remain committed to enabling connectivity in some of India's most remote regions, while advancing our ESG goals through innovation and responsible operations. In FY 2024-25, we achieved 99.81% network uptime, driven by strategic resource deployment and engineering upgrades. We extended the life span of equipment, reducing waste, and augmented existing DG capacities to avoid additional diesel consumption. Our shift to Li— Ion battery technology and continued electrification of sites reflect our focus on energy efficiency and environmental stewardship. We operate with integrity, guided by a strong Code of Conduct and robust audit mechanisms that ensure transparency and compliance. Our infrastructure not only connects people — it supports inclusive growth and sustainable development. As we move forward, we remain focused on enhancing uptime, reducing our carbon footprint, and delivering long—term value to all stakeholders. 7. Statement by director responsible for the business responsibility report, highlighting ESG related challenges, targets and achievements (listed entity has flexibility regarding the placement of this disclosure)

Network uptime remains the cornerstone of our value proposition to our telecom customers. We have successfully maintained high availability standards across sites ensuring seamless connectivity for millions of users. Based on the operational themes and strategic context, the focus is on aligning activities with achieving goals while addressing emerging challenges. Priority is given to resource optimization, risk mitigation, and timely execution. Stakeholder coordination and clear communication strategies enhance operational effectiveness. Continuous monitoring enables dynamic adjustments to maintain strategic alignment. Overall, actions are designed to maximize impact and ensure sustainable outcomes. As we move forward, the pillars of our strategy remain clear, to maintain focus on our core objectives and priorities, strengthen collaboration across all teams and stakeholders, continuously innovate while leveraging existing strengths, monitor performance metrics and adapt proactively while upholding transparency, accountability, and sustainable growth. I would like to express my gratitude to our shareholders, our valued telecom partners, and our dedicated team. Their continued trust and efforts enable us to remain at the forefront of India’s digital infrastructure story. We enter the new fiscal year with confidence, focused on delivering reliable connectivity while building a greener, more sustainable future for our stakeholders.
